title: CF Industries Holdings, Inc. Announces Agreement to Acquire Faustina Ammonia Production Facility from The Mosaic Company
body_markdown:
CF Industries Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CF), a global leader in ammonia and nitrogen fertilizer production, today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement with The Mosaic Company (NYSE: MOS) to acquire Mosaic’s Faustina ammonia production facility in St. James, Louisiana, and related ammonia storage and logistics assets for a total transaction value of $600 million, including $240 million allocated to a long-term ammonia offtake agreement between the two companies.


CF Industries expects to apply its ammonia production and operating expertise to improve reliability and increase annual production at the Faustina facility to approximately 570,000 tons by 2030, an increase of up to 90 percent compared to the facility’s average production over the past five years. The Company estimates these improvements could make approximately 270,000 additional tons of ammonia available annually to boost nitrogen and phosphate fertilizer production and support both agricultural and industrial consumers, including customers across the Corn Belt.


"The acquisition of the Faustina facility represents disciplined capital deployment and an opportunity to create value through operational excellence," said Chris Bohn, president and chief executive officer of CF Industries Holdings, Inc. "We believe our proven ability to operate assets safely, reliably and at high utilization rates will enable us to significantly increase ammonia production at Faustina, increasing fertilizer availability for consumers across the Corn Belt and North America, strengthen our nitrogen production and distribution network, and create value for long-term shareholders."


CF Industries expects to use an approach at Faustina similar to the one applied at its Waggaman, Louisiana, Complex following that facility’s acquisition in 2023. Since then, the Company’s investments and operating expertise have increased ammonia production at Waggaman by approximately 40 percent, resulting in approximately 260,000 additional tons of annual ammonia production compared to average output before CF Industries began operating the facility.


**Agreement Overview**


- Acquisition includes the Faustina, Louisiana ammonia production facility, which has recently produced ammonia at a rate of approximately 300,000 tons per year.
- Acquisition also includes related ammonia storage and logistics assets, including:
- The transaction has a total value of **$600 million,** including:
- CF Industries expects to invest approximately **$100 million over three years** to improve facility reliability, logistics capability, operational performance and ammonia production rates.
- CF Industries will evaluate the addition of carbon dioxide dehydration and compression equipment that could support the future production of **low-carbon ammonia** through permanent carbon dioxide sequestration.
- The transaction is expected to preserve approximately **50 high-quality manufacturing jobs in Louisiana** .


Ammonia produced at the Faustina facility is currently used primarily to manufacture phosphate fertilizers. CF Industries expects the facility to generate gross margin per ton consistent with its existing ammonia network before anticipated synergies. The Company expects to realize additional value through higher capacity utilization, improved operating performance, logistics and distribution optimization, and savings related to procurement and spare parts.


The transaction has been unanimously approved by the boards of directors of both companies and remains subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions.


**Goldman Sachs & Co., LLC,** served as financial adviser to CF Industries. **Skadden Arps Slate Meagher & Flom LLP and Phelps Dunbar LLP** served as legal advisers.


**About CF Industries Holdings, Inc.**


At CF Industries, our mission is to provide clean energy to feed and fuel the world sustainably. With our employees focused on safe and reliable operations, environmental stewardship, and disciplined capital and corporate management, we are on a path to decarbonize our ammonia production network – the world’s largest – to enable low-carbon hydrogen and nitrogen products for energy, fertilizer, emissions abatement and other industrial activities. Our manufacturing complexes in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, an unparalleled storage, transportation and distribution network in North America, and logistics capabilities enabling a global reach underpin our strategy to leverage our unique capabilities to accelerate the world’s transition to clean energy. CF Industries routinely posts investor announcements and additional information on the Company’s website at www.cfindustries.com and encourages those interested in the Company to check there frequently.
